sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with an Ogor Mawtribes army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Ogor Mawtribes units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/ - or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Pick an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Pick a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Gutbully | 10 | 150
Gutmaster | 30 | 250
Gutlord | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

Effect: If this unit charged in the previous turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

sections.name: Step 5 - Pick a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-10DP
HINTERLANDS BEAST: Rhinoxen, maulhounds, ill-tempered mournfangs: all these hulking creatures, and more besides, are ridden by ogor champions.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Horns, Teeth and Claws
Charge (+1 Damage), Companion | 4 | 4+ | 2+ | 1 | 2
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 10.
Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Battle Mount
-20DP
PRIMEVAL MONSTER: This massive beast is a relic of another age, a primordial monstrosity that survived thanks to travelling far towards the Realm’s Edge, before it was leashed and tamed by an ogor.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Huge Horns
Charge (+1 Damage), Companion | 7 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 3
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Huge Horns is 4.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 16.
Change the Save characteristic to 3+.
Change the Control characteristic to 10.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the MONSTER keyword.

sections.text:
